verdict.rationale: Agents can produce Rive content programmatically: RML is a text-based representation for building Rive files with coding agents, an agent-facing CLI exists, and an MCP server connects AI tools to the Editor. The open-source runtimes load and draw .riv files through a renderer abstraction with GPU backends. However, no evidence shows an agent-callable export or render step that produces screenshots, images, or production files, and community users note there is no movie/video export. missing for 10: documented programmatic export of .riv or other production formats via CLI/MCP, agent-accessible screenshot/image rendering, video export, independent hands-on corroboration.
